speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN) secondary to antibiotic hypersensitivity (Amoxicillin/Cephalexin). The negative infectious workup combined with the temporal relationship to the antibiotic course and your flank pain, fever, and fatigue is highly suggestive of this allergic kidney injury. We will proceed with monitoring your creatinine and electrolytes, and I will likely recommend switching to a non-penicillin alternative or corticosteroids depending on your renal function trends.
